text: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: envelope sig uses JWS General JSON Serialization (RFC 7515 §7.2.1) with unencoded detached payload; one entry per required signer over the same exact bytes; verifier checks every required party (per object definition) signed; signing order irrelevant. Same rule for single-signer objects (one entry). Convert all embedded body signatures (relaySig/billingSig, homeAdminSig/guestAdminSig, etc.).
